nodes.label: .`an accepted result with matching identity resolves to Accepted`()
.`a rejected result with matching identity resolves to Rejected carrying the error details`()
.`a result with a mismatched bagCode is treated as an identity mismatch, not applied`()
.`a result with a mismatched collectionId is treated as an identity mismatch`()
.`a result with a mismatched deviceId or operatorSessionId is treated as an identity mismatch`()
.`a well-formed accepted result marks the stored PENDING row ACCEPTED and emits`()
.`a well-formed rejected result marks the stored PENDING row REJECTED with error details and emits`()
.`an unknown inResponseToMessageId is dropped without crashing and leaves the dao unchanged`()
.`an identity-mismatched result leaves the stored row PENDING and unchanged, no emit`()
.`an empty malformed JSON payload is dropped without crashing`()
.`a result for an already-ACCEPTED row is a no-op, status stays ACCEPTED, no emit`()
